one_liner: LiveAgent helpdesk has a documented REST API v3 that uses admin-generated API keys. The vendor lists a built-in MCP server as an Enterprise feature. Working access comes through a 30-day trial or a paid plan.
auth_notes: The API v3 docs tell you to generate an API key and then authorize with scopes in the docs UI. The supplied pages show no general OAuth flow for the REST API. The draft's OAuth 2.1 claim for the MCP server came from a page not included in the fetched text, so I dropped OAUTH2 from the list. Keys belong to one account (domain), so each customer needs its own key.
access_notes: The 30-day free trial needs no credit card, and the API docs recommend a trial account for testing. A FAQ item mentions a "LiveAgent Free plan", which contradicts the draft's "no free tier" claim. The pages don't say whether that plan includes API access, so this is unresolved. The MCP server is listed among Enterprise plan benefits ($3,999/month).
blocker_notes: REST API testing works on a 30-day trial, and long-term use needs a paid plan. A free plan may exist, but the pages don't show whether it includes the API. The MCP server is listed as an Enterprise feature. Setup is per customer, with its own domain and API key.
